*Ink’s foot slammed into the break, force sending the car's engine sputtering and screeching as tires swerved off to avoid black crumbled from on the street with a spur of his wrist. His grip on the wheel was tight, knuckles wihte from the cheer force as his skull spun. Frantically scrambling to catch up to his thoughts as fast as possible. Breathing wavered; slipping past his teeth in minute huffs, hands loosening briefling on the wheel as he pulled away with hunched shoulders. Starts how he fought the urge to scream. But he didn’t. A sigh escaped him, long and drawn out as he spared a glance out the car window to his right. Pitch black of night only broken by the mere flicking of now totaled headlights.* 

**Wait-** 

*His gaze snapped back to the left, hands scrambling with the seatbelt with a cilck. Pushing the car door open with rushed movements as his thoughts finally clicked. What was that? An animal? Someone’s pet? Stars he hoped he hadn’t hit whatever it was.*
